definition: the act of signing up or enrolling
description: A close shot shows a hand writing a name into a spiral-bound book headed REGISTRATION, with other names already filled in. Two smiling staff in lanyards hand a printed name badge across the counter to a guest. Behind the desk more staff work with stacks of forms, badge printers and card scanners while a queue waits. The camera pulls back to show an enormous convention hall with a huge crowd lined up at long check-in tables.

taps.phrase: to hand over a name badge

en.question: What is the woman with glasses doing?

de.answer: Sie überreicht dem Gast ein Namensschild.
de.question: Was macht die Frau mit Brille?

es.answer: Le está entregando una credencial al invitado.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de las gafas?

fr.answer: Elle remet un badge à l'invité.
